instruction.text: Dascha ist auf eine Präsentation zu Australien gestoßen. Sieh sie dir an.

atoms.b: • Australia is located in the Southern Hemisphere
atoms.sound: Australia is located in the Southern Hemisphere.

atoms.b: • Distance between UK and Australia about 9,500 miles
atoms.sound: The distance from the United Kingdom to Australia is about 9,500 miles if you go by plane.

atoms.b: • Commonwealth of Australia's official flag (Australian Blue Ensign)
atoms.sound: This is the official flag of the Commonwealth of Australia. It is also called the Australian Blue Ensign. It consists of the United Kingdom's Union Jack and six white stars.

This is the Commonwealth Coat of Arms. A shield with symbols of Australia's six states, is held up by the native Australian animals, the kangaroo and the emu. The Commonwealth Star above also represents the states and territories, while floral emblems appear below the shield

atoms.b:
• Six states and ten territories
On the main continent: New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, Western Australia, South Australia, Tasmania, Jervis Bay Territory, Northern Territory and the Capital Territory
atoms.sound: Australia consists of six states and ten territories. On the main continent there are New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, Western Australia, South Australia, Tasmania, Jervis Bay Territory, Northern Territory and the Capital Territory
Australia's capital city is Canberra, the biggest city however is Sydney

instruction.text: Vervollständige die Präsentation mithilfe der Bilder.

atoms.b: Australia's head of state is the King of the United Kingdom. Australia is therefore a federal parliamentary constitutional ((++monarchy democracy)).
There is no official language, but ((++English French)) is the most commonly used language.
Australia is the oldest as well as the ((++driest wettest)) inhabited continent with the least fertile soil.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>fertile</voice> bedeutet fruchtbar <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>soil</voice> bedeutet Boden

atoms.b: The country is megadiverse: Due to its size there are ((++various only_a_few)) different landscapes and climates.
The centre is characterised by ((++deserts forests)).
In the north-east you can find tropical ((++rainforests fields)).
Additionally, Australia has got ((++mountain_ranges lakes)) to offer in the south-east.
